event_traceability.method: F1 paragraphs whose event_ids all resolve to real events / all F1 paragraphs

system_log_leakage.method: quoted spans equal to a template summary or matching the `word @ word` log pattern

scene_repetition_rate.method: valueless-repeat paragraphs (similar wording, no new event, no new fact) / all paragraphs; layer-3 narrative-value judgement requires human sampling

emotional_coverage.method: character x scene records with a non-unknown emotion / all records

motivation_coverage.method: key actions (importance >= 0.5 speech/search/confront) carrying >=1 MOTIVATED_BY hypothesis / all key actions

fact_consistency.method: deterministic: 5 - violations (non-verbatim quotes, F1 without ids, log leakage)

dialogue_naturalness.method: LLM reviewer score (independent reviewer role) — judgement, NOT objective fact
